candidate.answerReason: The fundamental theorem of vectors in space uses three noncoplanar vectors as a basis.

methods.label: Recall the spatial basis condition
methods.explanation: A basis for a plane uses 2 noncollinear vectors, while a basis for space uses 3 noncoplanar vectors.
methods.levelReason: Directly recalls the spatial-vector theorem and compares it with the earlier plane-vector theorem.
